All 3,000 seating_schedule.csv ids match the .blend (max deviation 1.5e-6 m) and the IFC (3,000 IfcFurniture SeatType=congregation, CountsTowardTarget=True; max deviation 2e-6 m; 1,404 L00 / 1,596 L01). BVH mesh test of 3,174 chairs against 1,167 non-slab solids: 0 intersections. SGT-01/02 C-values 0.0603 / 0.1202 and GEO-05 uniform rear riser bands 0.150/0.120/0.135 unchanged from iteration 2. circulation_accessibility.notes: Resolved and verified from model geometry: stair-head landings are now 2.70 x 2.76 m (ARC-STAIR-FOYER-1 landing x 11.55-14.25, y 5.09-7.85, etc.) and the guardrail ARC-RAIL-UPPER-FOYER-EDGE is open over each full landing (rail gaps 11.55-14.25, 14.75-17.45, 41.55-47.45 incl. column F2; 2.7 m per stair), so EGR-02 10.8 m vs 7.45 m is now genuine; paired landings flank columns C2/F2 and the flights pass south of the grid-2 columns with 0 mesh clashes and 4.27 m headroom. Nearest-exit definition is now consistent: 0 seats list travel shorter than straight-line to the listed nearest exit (was 557); nearest/balanced/route loads in seating_schedule.csv reconcile with exit_schedule.csv after the 60 wheelchair-position occupants and 200 platform/choir occupants. NEW REGRESSION: moving the toilet entrances to the side passages left the foyer accessible WCs with no entrance - SPC-SP-WCA-W (x 9.6-14.0) and SPC-SP-WCA-E (x 45.0-49.4) are enclosed by solid partitions ARC-WALL-WC-*-ACC, -S, -E/-W (8-vertex boxes, no openings) and the hall wall; the only doors DR-WC-W-MAIN (x=5.0) and DR-WC-E-MAIN (x=54.0) open into the female/male toilets; floor_plan.png shows no door to 'Acc. WC W/E' while A-17 claims 4 foyer accessible WCs. Persisting: travel to nearest hall exit 39.7 m (330 occupants > 30 m flag), queue-balanced 50.9 m, external 61.2 m (10 > 60 m), and the shortest-route-to-outside sensitivity loads the cross-aisle exits with 1,032/1,022 persons (5.16/5.11 m vs 3.6 m) - all logged with a restriction on use (OI-05, OI-17) but no layout mitigation modelled in three iterations. Foyer stair flights pass 10 mm from columns B2/D2/E2/G2 and have no guard/handrail on their open sides (rising to +3.985 m). Not a critical blocker because use restrictions are explicit, but the accessible WC regression contradicts a brief requirement.

validation_traceability.notes: Iteration-2 false positives resolved: EGR-02 now reflects measured stair-head openings, and tests/test_layout.py test_stair_head_openings_from_rail_geometry measures rail gaps over each top landing (genuine, independent of stair metadata); test_travel_not_shorter_than_straight_line covers the nearest-exit metric (reviewer's independent check: 0 violations). Storey overrides tested. No invented standards, calculations or compliance/approval claims found ('kN' hits in the IFC are GlobalId substrings). Deductions: no test that every IfcSpace/room is reachable through a door, which let the accessible-WC regression pass all 28 tests and all IFC checks; no stair-to-column clearance test (10 mm); no check that exported quantities agree with element properties (stair width, ramp rise); EGR-02 uses a different load basis than the declared nearest-exit definition; brace/strut-to-column connectivity not checked (10 mm gaps).
